jobs.title: Regional HR Specialist
jobs.description: Job Summary Regional HR Specialist Department: Human Resources Reports To: Human Resources Manager FLSA Status: Non-Exempt Company Summary EMJ is a leading supplier of Steel and Aluminum Bar, Tubing, and Plate to manufacturing companies in North America and around the world. Our broad network of facilities, superior inventories, extensive value-added processing capabilities, and world-class technology enables EMJ to provide unsurpassed service to our customers. The Regional Human Resources Specialist provides direct administrative and operational support to the HR function and site leadership within a specific region. This role involves assisting with daily HR activities, including supporting the hiring process, managing onboarding, maintaining HRIS, generating reports, and providing employee support. Under the guidance of the HR Manager, the HR Specialist ensures that HR processes are executed accurately, confidentially, and in compliance with company policies and applicable laws. What We Offer • Medical, dental, and vision coverage with affordable employee contribution rates. • 401(k) plan with company match up to 4%. • Life and AD&D insurance, short- and long-term disability coverage. • Employee Assistance Program (EAP), including counseling, legal, and financial support. • Paid Time Off (PTO) and 9 paid holidays. • Flexible Spending Accounts for healthcare and dependent care. • Wellness incentives and access to LiveHealth Online. • Employee discount program with over 30,000 deals. • Community engagement and volunteer opportunities. Physical Requirements Stand or Sit(Stationary position), Walk(Move, Traverse), Use hand/fingers to handle or feel (Operate, Activate, Use, Prepare, Inspect, Place, Detect, Position), Stoop, kneel, crouch, or Crawl(Position self(to), Move), Talk/hear(Communicate, Detect, Converse with, Discern, Convey, Express oneself, Exchange information), See (Detect, Determine, Perceive, Identify, Recognize, Judge, Observe, Inspect, Estimate, Assess), Reaching, Repetitive Motion Function in the Job Sedentary Work- Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally, and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects, including the human body. Sedentary work involves sitting most of the time. Jobs are sedentary if walking and standing are required only occasionally, and all other sedentary criteria are met. Job Function Partner with the Recruitment Specialist to execute the recruitment process, while maintaining clear role delineation, with the Recruiting Specialist owning job postings, sourcing, pipeline, candidate prescreening and communication, while the Regional HR Specialist owns onsite interviews, hiring manager alignment, hiring decision and post-offer onboarding activities. Prepare and coordinate pre-employment documentation, drug testing, and background checks. Ensure Day 1 readiness, including onboarding logistics and timely completion of employment and compliance documentation. Conduct new hire orientation and ensure all onboarding documentation is complete and accurate. Enter, update, and maintain employee data in HR systems (Dayforce) and ensure accuracy of employee records. Maintain employment documentation, including compliance records (e.g., MVR recertification), ensuring completeness and audit readiness. Review timesheets, payroll registers, and employee record changes for accuracy, compliance, and reasonableness. Support PTO tracking, job code accuracy, wage changes, and payroll adjustments. Coordinate with payroll on garnishments, deductions, bonuses/incentives, and corrections to ensure accurate processing. Ensure compensation changes and wage increases are properly documented, approved, and processed. Support execution of performance management processes, including tracking, documentation, and coordination of administrative requirements. Assist managers with disciplinary documentation under HR Manager guidance. Respond to routine employee questions and concerns, escalating complex or sensitive matters as appropriate. Support resolution of employee relations issues in partnership with HR Manager. Communicate and reinforce HR policies and procedures, escalating interpretation or complex inquiries as needed. Support compliance with labor laws, collective bargaining agreements, DOT requirements, and internal audits through accurate recordkeeping and process adherence. Assist with benefits administration, including employee inquiries and enrollment support. Support annual open enrollment and wellness initiatives by communicating key information and providing materials. Identify and escalate development gaps, performance concerns, or succession risks to HR Manager for follow-up and action planning. Coordinate offboarding activities and ensure completion of exit documentation. Provide cross-coverage and support to other Regional HR Specialists as needed to ensure continuity of HR operations. Supplemental Duties and Responsibilities All other duties and responsibilities assigned by management. Required Skills High School diploma/GED required, Bachelor degree preferred. 0-5 years of relevant experience or any equivalent combination of education and experience that provides the required knowledge, skills, and abilities required; Prior Human Resources experience preferred Bilingual English/Spanish preferred Excellent customer service/human relations skills Prior HRIS data entry and reporting experience preferred Ability to multi-task, prioritize, and manage time effectively required. Ability to exercise discretion when handling sensitive/confidential employment information required. Understanding of basic concepts and principles pertinent to Human Resources management operations required. Excellent oral and written communication skills required. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills required. Ability to make sound decisions based on a combination of factors including analysis, knowledge and experience, and judgment required. Ability to initiate and maintain cooperative relationships with co-workers as well as internal/external customers required. Strong computer proficiency and working knowledge of Microsoft applications (Excel, Word, PowerPoint), as well as general HR software platforms and internet-based search engines required. jobs.title: GRC Analyst III
jobs.description: Job Summary The GRC Analyst III serves as a lead contributor within the Information Security organization and will help design, build, and mature Reliance’s enterprise Governance, Risk & Compliance program from the ground up. This role will lead day-to-day GRC program execution, including GRC platform implementation, control framework development, policy and exception governance, enterprise risk tracking, compliance evidence management, third-party risk coordination, and executive-ready reporting. The GRC Analyst III will partner closely with Information Security, IT, Internal Audit, Corporate Risk, Legal, Procurement, business stakeholders, and control owners to establish scalable, repeatable, and audit-defensible processes. This position requires a hands-on lead who can translate regulatory and security requirements into practical operating procedures, drive accountability across teams, mentor junior contributors, and help create the foundation for a mature, measurable, enterprise-wide GRC capability. Physical Requirements Stand or Sit(Stationary position), Walk(Move, Traverse), Use hand/fingers to handle or feel (Operate, Activate, Use, Prepare, Inspect, Place, Detect, Position), Talk/hear(Communicate, Detect, Converse with, Discern, Convey, Express oneself, Exchange information), See (Detect, Determine, Perceive, Identify, Recognize, Judge, Observe, Inspect, Estimate, Assess), Reaching, Repetitive Motion Function in the Job Sedentary Work- Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally, and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects, including the human body. Sedentary work involves sitting most of the time. Jobs are sedentary if walking and standing are required only occasionally, and all other sedentary criteria are met. Job Function GRC Program Buildout & Leadership – Lead the implementation and operational buildout of Reliance’s enterprise Governance, Risk & Compliance program. Help define the target-state GRC operating model, including program processes, roles and responsibilities, intake channels, workflows, reporting expectations, and governance routines. Lead configuration, rollout, data quality, and continuous improvement of the GRC platform, including risk registers, control libraries, assessment workflows, issue tracking, exception management, and dashboards. Create practical procedures, templates, standards, and operating documentation that allow the GRC program to scale across business units and control owners. Risk Management & Control Governance – Establish repeatable processes for identifying, assessing, documenting, and reporting information security and compliance risk. Lead risk assessments with technical, business, and compliance stakeholders; document risks, control gaps, compensating controls, remediation plans, owners, due dates, and residual risk decisions. Develop and maintain risk dashboards, KPIs, KRIs, and leadership reporting that communicate risk posture, remediation progress, exception aging, audit readiness, and control performance. Translate findings from assessments, audits, vulnerability reviews, vendor reviews, and security tools into prioritized risk records and action plans. Policy, Standards & Exception Management – Lead consistent governance practices for policy lifecycle management and risk-based exceptions. Coordinate policy and standard review cycles, stakeholder feedback, approvals, publication, acknowledgements, and related evidence. Design and operate an exception process covering intake, risk evaluation, documentation, approval routing, renewal cadence, and closure tracking. Partner with control owners to ensure exceptions clearly document business need, risk rationale, compensating controls, expiration dates, and remediation commitments. Audit, Compliance & Evidence Management – Build and operate audit-defensible processes for internal, external, and regulatory compliance activities. Coordinate evidence requests, control owner responses, issue tracking, remediation updates, and status reporting for internal audits, external audits, customer requests, and compliance assessments. Develop control evidence standards, evidence retention practices, testing support procedures, and quality checks to improve consistency and audit readiness. Support governance activities related to frameworks and obligations such as NIST, CIS Controls, SOC 2, CMMC, DFARS, and other applicable security or compliance requirements. Third-Party Risk & Cross-Functional Coordination – Lead governance activities that improve visibility into vendor, supplier, and service provider risk. Review vendor security questionnaires, SOC reports, certifications, contract security requirements, and due-diligence artifacts to identify and communicate risk. Partner with Procurement, Legal, Information Security, IT, and business owners to document risk decisions, track remediation, and improve third-party governance processes. Mentor junior team members and help establish consistent expectations for documentation quality, stakeholder follow-up, issue ownership, and executive-ready communication. Supplemental Duities Pursues training and development opportunities; strives to continuously build knowledge and skills Assist personnel in other IT departments to resolve technical and/or application issues Participates and assists with internal and external audits Other duties as requested Required Skills Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Risk Management, Business, Audit, or a related field; equivalent work experience may be considered. 7+ years of experience in GRC, information security, IT risk management, compliance, audit, third-party risk, or a related discipline, with demonstrated ownership of complex program or process areas. Experience helping implement, administer, or mature a GRC platform, including control libraries, risk registers, workflows, assessments, issue tracking, exception management, evidence repositories, and reporting dashboards. Strong working knowledge of common security, risk, and compliance frameworks such as NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-53, NIST SP 800-171, CIS Controls, ISO/IEC 27001, SOC 2, CMMC, DFARS, or similar control frameworks. Demonstrated ability to lead risk assessments, document control gaps, evaluate risk, define remediation plans, assign ownership, track due dates, and communicate status to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Experience coordinating internal audits, external audits, customer compliance requests, control testing support, evidence collection, issue remediation, and audit-ready documentation. Experience with policy lifecycle management, standards development, exception management, risk acceptance documentation, and governance reporting preferred. Experience reviewing vendor security artifacts such as SOC reports, questionnaires, certifications, security addenda, and remediation plans preferred. Ability to build structure in an evolving program, create repeatable processes, write clear procedures, define measurable outcomes, and drive accountability across multiple stakeholder groups. Strong analytical, organizational, documentation, and project coordination skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities in an enterprise environment. Strong written, verbal, and presentation communication skills, including the ability to translate technical, regulatory, and audit concepts into practical guidance and executive-ready reporting. Must be self-motivated, detail-oriented, and able to work independently with minimal supervision while partnering effectively with Information Security, IT, Internal Audit, Corporate Risk, Legal, Procurement, and business stakeholders. Professional certification preferred, such as CISA, CRISC, CGRC, CISM, CISSP, Security+, ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor, or Cyber AB CMMC Certified Professional. Compensation Range The anticipated compensation for this position is USD $120,000.00/Yr. - USD $140,000.00/Yr. depending on experience, qualifications, and location. EEO Statement Reliance, Inc.
